lesson_intro: Today we study the 'World Common Law' (Ulaga Podhumarai)—Thirukkural. Composed by Thiruvalluvar, this masterpiece is the soul of Tamil ethics. It is divided into 3 sections (Aram, Porul, Inbam), 133 chapters (Adhikarams), and 1330 couplets. For TNPSC, you must know the structure, the various names given to the book, and the meaning of key Kurals prescribed in the Samacheer syllabus. This is the only book that can get you marks in both General Tamil AND General Studies (Unit 8).
